paper_title: Searching for dark matter with a 1000 km baseline interferometer
notes: Paper reports new exclusion limits on ALP-neutron coupling g_aNN < 10^-9 GeV^-1 in the mass range 10^-22 to 4×10^-14 eV (nine orders of magnitude). The experiment uses two K-Rb-3He comagnetometers separated by ~860 km to search for ALP dark matter via gradient-spin interactions. Data points extracted from Figures 4, 5, 6 and abstract statement. The limits improve previous laboratory constraints by up to three orders of magnitude for neutron and proton couplings. The paper also constrains AxionProton (g_aPP < 10^-7 GeV^-1) and AxionElectron (g_aee < 10^-6 GeV^-1) couplings. Local DM density of 0.4 GeV/cm^3 is assumed per Eq. (2) and text. Confidence level is 95% (CLs method, Eq. 13). The coupling values are in GeV^-1 as stated in abstract and throughout paper. | selector: text (sole candidate)
